description: Trust a custom hostname, IP literal, or wildcard for organisation egress, widening permitted outbound destinations. Use list_egress_allowlist to inspect existing trust first. Portkey rejects metadata destinations and duplicates. Returns the new UUID and normalized domain; requires organisation permission.

description.description: Optional description (up to 500 characters); null clears it

domain.description: Exact hostname, IPv4/IPv6 literal (optionally bracketed), or *. wildcard. No scheme, path, credentials, or port. Portkey trims/lowercases it and rejects cloud-metadata destinations

name: create_egress_allowlist_entry

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
